issues.title: Combine over an empty or all-null list returned an empty string instead of null
issues.evidence: Official CQL string operator XML expects Combine({}) and Combine({}, '-') to evaluate to null. Direct DuckDB macros returned ''.
issues.fix: Updated Combine and CombineSep SQL macros to return NULL when the non-null filtered list is empty.
issues.verification: Covered by translated native-loaded and forced Python fallback execution plus no-Python/browser-style direct macro probes.

issues.title: Substring boundary handling returned empty strings or slices for null-result cases
issues.evidence: Substring('ab', 2), Substring('ab', 3), and Substring('ab', 0, -1) should return null; direct macros, translated SQL, and deprecated Python UDF paths did not consistently enforce that.
issues.fix: Added start-at/past-end and negative-length guards to Substring, SubstringLen, translated Substring lowering, and stringSubstring.
issues.verification: Covered by CQL-12 regression pytest in native-loaded, forced Python fallback, and no-Python/browser-style macro execution.

issues.title: Translated StartsWith and EndsWith used SQL LIKE wildcard semantics
issues.evidence: StartsWith('abc', 'a%') and EndsWith('abc', '_c') incorrectly evaluated as true when translated through LIKE; CQL requires literal prefix/suffix matching.
issues.fix: Changed translator lowering to call StartsWith and EndsWith macros directly. Deprecated Python stringStartsWith/stringEndsWith/stringContains now return NULL for null search operands instead of throwing.
issues.verification: Covered by translation-shape assertions and backend parity execution for wildcard-literal inputs.

issues.title: String bracket indexing used list extraction instead of CQL string Indexer semantics
issues.evidence: 'ab'[2] lowered through LIST_EXTRACT and returned an empty string instead of null for the at-end index.
issues.fix: Added string-source detection for indexer lowering and route string indexers through the public Indexer macro.
issues.verification: Covered by translated native-loaded and forced Python fallback execution for string indexer boundary behavior.
